timestamps.note: The first timestamp was recorded after source review began; no earlier start time is asserted.

method: Read current bounded product sources, both changed test files and the existing MCP UI test file. Independently checked source hashes against repair evidence; checked all referenced validation artifact hashes; read final green stdout/raw results and definitive contract-fixture red raw assertion failures. No tests were rerun and no product files were edited.

observations.result: ownField reads only own properties; withField uses computed property creation and deletes only from a cloned record. Question drafts, top-level elicitation values, top-level MCP arguments and nested SchemaField values consistently use those helpers. Object.fromEntries builds answer maps without invoking the legacy __proto__ setter. Current tests verify __proto__ and constructor start absent, require explicit answers where applicable, remain own keys and survive JSON stringify/parse.

observations.area: Schema validation and adjacent dictionary operations
observations.result: Object schema validation first checks Object.hasOwn(properties,key), so undeclared prototype names follow additionalProperties policy and declared names receive their actual schemas. Required checks also guard ownership. Permission checkbox writes use withField; approval labels use ownField with fallback. These adjacent changes are consistent defensive handling, not new independently established protocol-flow findings.

The none/option-index/other union is separate from text and otherText. DOM option tokens contain indices or a mode token; submitted labels are obtained from the selected option. Literal __other is preserved both as an option and as free text. Other mode is accepted and displayed only when isOther is true. Empty input remains rejected; whitespace is not trimmed. Distinct option indices also avoid label collisions with mode tokens.

Functional draft updates preserve sibling fields and question ids. Switching away from other mode retains otherText; extraction into a top-level UserInputForm does not introduce a new render-time component identity. Parent fieldset disabled state and the sending ref remain responsible for busy controls and single-flight sends. Existing tests cover failure unlocking with retained secret other input, collapse/expand retention and duplicate-submit prevention; the new switch-mode test preserves custom whitespace and password/autocomplete behavior.

McpArguments uses the same safe helper for root fields and shared SchemaField recursion for nested fields. Parameter mutations still reset explicit confirmation. Existing omission/null/false/zero/empty-value tests remain, and new top-level/nested special-name tests assert own JSON keys and removal. Existing MCP integration tests exercise ordinary discovered arguments through explicit confirmation and assert one mcp/tool/call payload.

Current seven changed-file hashes and the unchanged MCP UI hash match forms.json. All 12 referenced stdout/raw artifact hashes match. Definitive red raw results contain 14 assertion failures and 17 passes. Final raw results and stdout agree on 66 passes, zero failures and zero pending: prompts 19, prompt-fields 12, mcp-ui 35. The reported final TypeScript stdout is empty and its hash matches; TypeScript was not rerun.

conclusion: No new actionable issue found within this bounded cross-review. The repaired key-handling and selection-state paths are consistent with the inspected tests and recorded validation.
